history.summary: THIS IS A JAIN TIRTHA, NOT A HINDU TEMPLE — keep-or-drop decision needed. Shri Manilaxmi Shwetambara Jain Tirth at Manej village, Petlad taluka, Anand district (CSV town corrected from Anand to Manej), on the Vadodara-Bhavnagar highway (NH-8) near Tarapur Chowkdi and Dharmaj. Construction began in 2009 and was completed in February 2017; the pran pratishtha / Anjan Salaka Mahotsav was held on 24 February 2017. Built by the Shah Lakshmichand Charitable Trust, Thaliya Nagar, Manej, on a ~44-acre campus with a ~31,000 sq ft white-marble jinalaya dedicated to Tirthankara Muni Suvrat Swami. Known for its elaborate night lighting, well-kept gardens, bhojansala and limited guest rooms (advance booking advised); visitor reviews report photography is prohibited inside and modest dress is required (verify). Coordinates are an APPROXIMATE village-level pin — verify.

town_description: Manej is a village in Petlad taluka of Anand district, on the Vadodara-Bhavnagar highway (NH-8) near Tarapur Chowkdi and Dharmaj. It is an agricultural village in the Charotar region, and the large Jain tirtha complex on the highway is its best-known landmark.
